Folks — I spoke with the CS and finance leads for NorthRidge to validate the ask. Summary: customer is doing a multi-week validation and wants both a deployment credit and an SLA buffer to avoid early regeneration costs.

Proposed concession package (internal recommendation):
- One-time operational credit: $150,000 (applied as invoice credit across first two invoices)
- Temporary SLA uplift: 99.95% for first 6 months post renewal. Provide service report cadence monthly for that period.
- Term reset: move anniversary to 2027-06-30 to align with NorthRidge fiscal planning (no increase in total committed spend; restructure billing schedule instead)

Financials: with the above, we model a blended 18% effective first-year concession vs. baseline pricing but the account renews at the same ARR base thereafter. The ask is strategic — NorthRidge is a referenceable analytics customer and they are evaluating expansion into our Dedicated product in 2027.

Approval path needed: Deal Desk sign-off (Prio: priyom_das), plus Sales Leader concurrence (Marissa). If Deal Desk approves, Legal should be able to sign an amendment for SLA addendum + credit schedule.

I attach the proposed offer sheet for review (redwood_offer_sheet_nr139.xlsx).

Vivek Kulkarni

Marissa / team — reviewing now. A few notes and a recommended modification before I greenlight:

- One-time credit: $150k looks acceptable provided the credit is tied to milestone verification (3 checkpoints: validation sign-off, production cutover, 30-day stability report). Please document those milestones in the amendment language.
- SLA uplift: 99.95% for 6 months is OK. Add an automatic rollback clause after 6 months and include monitored exceptions (maintenance windows).
- Term reset: acceptable if we preserve contract value over the first 12 months following reset; we should not extend the commitment period beyond 12 months without additional commercial consideration.

If Sales agrees to milestone gating and the rollback clause, Deal Desk approves this exception. Legal should draft a concise amendment: credit schedule, SLA addendum, and revised billing term. Once Legal has a draft I will sign off.

Please confirm the milestone language and I will issue formal approval before COB tomorrow.
